mapper.select: SELECT FROM task t WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.deleted = 0

SELECT t.id, t.project_id, p.name AS project_name, t.source, t.title, t.status, t.priority, AS level, t.branch_name, t.blocking_decision_id, t.attempt_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.token_input + r.token_cached_input + r.token_output), 0) FROM task_run r WHERE r.task_id = t.id) AS tokens, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF( MICROSECOND, r.started_at, COALESCE(r.finished_at, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ), 0)), 0) DIV 1000 FROM task_run r WHERE r.task_id = t.id) AS execution_millis, t.started_at, t.finished_at, t.created_at, t.updated_at FROM task t JOIN project p ON p.id = t.project_id WHERE ORDER BY t.priority DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM task t WHERE t.deleted = 0 GROUP BY status

SELECT DATE(DATE_ADD(t.finished_at, INTERVAL #{offsetMinutes} MINUTE)) AS day, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS done, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed FROM task t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.status IN ('DONE', 'FAILED') AND t.finished_at >= #{from} AND t.finished_at < #{to} GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

mapper.select: SELECT FROM task t JOIN project p ON p.id = t.project_id AND p.enabled = 1 AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE t.project_id = #{projectId} AND ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.status = 'QUEUED' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, t.priority DESC, t.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT t.id, t.project_id, t.requirement_id, t.bug_id, t.source, t.title, t.prompt, t.status, t.priority, t.codex_thread_id, t.branch_name, t.blocking_decision_id, t.attempt_count, t.started_at, t.finished_at, t.created_at, t.updated_at FROM task t JOIN project p ON p.id = t.project_id AND p.enabled = 1 AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND (t.status IN ('PENDING', 'QUEUED') OR (t.status = 'RUNNING' AND t.codex_thread_id IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT r.status FROM task_run r WHERE r.task_id = t.id ORDER BY r.attempt_no DESC LIMIT 1) = 'BLOCKED')) ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.status = 'QUEUED' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, t.priority DESC, t.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM task t JOIN project p ON p.id = t.project_id AND p.enabled = 1 AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.status = 'QUEUED' ORDER BY t.priority DESC, t.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task (project_id, requirement_id, bug_id, source, title, prompt, status, priority, codex_thread_id, branch_name, blocking_decision_id, attempt_count, started_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{requirementId}, #{bugId}, #{source}, #{title}, #{prompt}, #{status}, #{priority}, #{codexThreadId}, #{branchName}, #{blockingDecisionId}, #{attemptCount}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE task SET status = #{status}, priority = #{priority}, codex_thread_id = #{codexThreadId}, branch_name = #{branchName}, blocking_decision_id = #{blockingDecisionId}, attempt_count = #{attemptCount}, started_at = #{startedAt}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE task SET title = #{title}, prompt = #{prompt}, priority = #{priority}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status <> 'DONE'
